channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: 3DMark
item.description: 3DMark is for gamers, overclockers and system builders who want to get more out of their hardware. With its wide range of benchmark tests, 3DMark has everything you need to test your PC or Mac's performance.

item.title: BATTLETECH
item.description: Take command of your own mercenary outfit of 'Mechs and the MechWarriors that pilot them, struggling to stay afloat as you find yourself drawn into a brutal interstellar civil war.

item.title: BLOODLETTER
item.description: A grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

item.title: Farewells clicker
item.description: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

item.title: INDIKA
item.description: Play a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia at the turn of the XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. INDIKA tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself.

item.title: Lossless Scaling
item.description: All-in-one gaming utility for frame generation and scaling

item.title: Medieval Horse Dealer Simulator
item.description: Trade horses, formulate feed, and breed generations of elite stallions, racehorses, draft mounts, war horses, and more. Train, auction, mine, forge, farm, run caravans, build a mercenary force, and deal with powerful lords. Dominate the medieval horse trade.

item.title: Nimbit Frontier
item.description: A cozy creature-collecting life sim with deep creature care, roguelite action, and a focus on nurturing, discovery, and atmosphere. Raise adorable Nimbits, build cozy custom habitats, and explore the shifting Underwild to uncover rare species and support their conservation.

item.title: Pachinko Farm
item.description: Pachinko Farm is a cozy yet chaotic incremental game where you drop balls to grow your farm in a fully physics-based pachinko world. Bonk → Produce → Sell

item.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
item.description: Rise from amateur to PBA legend in the most realistic bowling simulation ever made, featuring advanced physics, realistic oil pattern transition, licensed PBA pros, deep career progression, and multiple competitive game modes.

item.title: ploink
item.description: A chaotic plinko inspired roguelike with a focus on wacky items and creative setups. Design a board of random crap and fill the screen with balls and numbers. There are no bad items you just gotta figure out how to use them.

item.title: Solar Wave
item.description: A large-scale 4X strategy game with indirect control and a focus on simulating a space empire. Capture systems, develop your economy and logistics, call up hundreds of powerful fleets and watch them incinerate enemies of the Solar Empire.

item.title: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
item.description: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

item.title: The Mortuary Assistant
item.description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

item.title: The Pale Mimic
item.description: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it’s just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.

item.title: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
item.description: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure. Play as Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey, as you explore magical hand-drawn locations, meet charming characters, solve handcrafted puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes, and help the forest prepare for the coming winter.

item.title: WE ARE SO DEAD
item.description: A co-op seance horror game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them down 9 floors of a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-6 players.

item.title: Wrap House Simulator🌯
item.description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

item.title: Crownhold
item.description: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

item.title: Mad Games Tycoon 2
item.description: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

item.title: Melvor Idle: Atlas of Discovery
item.description: Atlas of Discovery, Melvor Idle’s second expansion, is all about exploration! Discover eight new Combat Areas packed with dozens of monsters to fight and hundreds of new items to find. Unlock two new exploration skills, try the all-new Ancient Relics Gamemode… and more!

item.title: Melvor Idle: Into the Abyss
item.description: Discover a new dimension to Melvor Idle as you descend into the Abyssal Realm! Encounter new challenges, unique environments and mechanics while mastering new Abyssal Skills. As you delve deeper, the stakes get higher… but will you rise to glory?

item.title: Melvor Idle: Throne of the Herald
item.description: Throne of the Herald expansion continues the story of our hero as you discover more about the mystic forces that surround the lands of Melvor, and the dark forces that remain hidden outside of the Capital. New locations to explore, new gear to craft, and even more monsters to fight!

item.title: Styx: Blades of Greed
item.description: The master of stealth is back! Explore the dizzying heights of the Iserian Continent and cunningly eliminate your enemies. Thanks to your Quartz powers, you are freer than ever. Be creative: Never has it felt so good to be greedy.

item.title: Deponia
item.description: In Deponia, the world has degenerated into a vast garbage dump, in which the crotchety Rufus ekes out his sorry existence.
